properties.name: aeg.iam.persistence.department-max-depth
properties.description: Maximum supported Department hierarchy depth. Values above 10 are rejected.

properties.name: aeg.iam.persistence.role-validation-enabled
properties.description: Fail startup when the runtime database role is not the expected non-owner, non-BYPASSRLS role.

properties.name: aeg.iam.persistence.expected-runtime-role
properties.description: Expected PostgreSQL runtime login role used by control-plane-app.

properties.name: aeg.iam.authentication.enabled
properties.description: Enable the Phase 1A-3 database-backed authentication application services. Disabled until IAM API integration is complete.

properties.name: aeg.iam.authentication.mfa-key-id
properties.description: Identifier persisted with AES-GCM protected TOTP secrets to support controlled key rotation.

properties.name: aeg.iam.authentication.mfa-master-key-base64
properties.description: Base64-encoded 32-byte AES-256 key used only when Phase 1A-3 authentication is enabled.

properties.name: aeg.iam.authentication.secret-pepper-base64
properties.description: Base64-encoded secret of at least 32 bytes used to HMAC recovery and one-time secrets.

properties.name: aeg.iam.authentication.totp-window
properties.description: Accepted TOTP time-step drift on either side of the current step. Allowed range is 0 through 2.

properties.name: aeg.iam.rbac.enabled
properties.description: Enable the Phase 1A-4 RBAC decision engine and shadow foundation. Existing business API enforcement remains legacy until later phases.

properties.name: aeg.iam.rbac.cache-maximum-size
properties.description: Maximum local authorization grant cache entries.

properties.name: aeg.iam.rbac.cache-ttl
properties.description: Short safety-net TTL for local authorization grants.

properties.name: aeg.iam.rbac.invalidation-channel
properties.description: Redis Pub/Sub fast-path channel for post-commit IAM cache invalidation.

properties.name: aeg.iam.rbac.shadow-match-sampling-rate
properties.description: Sampling rate for matching legacy/new authorization decisions. Mismatches are always critical.

properties.name: aeg.iam.rbac.shadow-sample-queue-capacity
properties.description: Bounded in-memory queue capacity for sampled matching Shadow Decisions.

properties.name: aeg.iam.rbac.shadow-max-metadata-entries
properties.description: Maximum sanitized metadata entries retained per Shadow Decision.
